head: Gemini Memory summary: see and delete what Gemini remembers about you
dek: Gemini now shows a Memory summary of what it knows about you, sorted into topics such as your background, work, travel and hobbies, and you can edit or delete any of it.
details: You can tell it "Add to my memory that I speak Japanese" or "Remove my old phone number". A Memory history shows when something was added or changed. For now it's for Google AI subscribers in US English with Keep Activity and Memory turned on, on the web first.
where: Gemini on the web, Google AI subscribers, US English
means: You can check what Gemini uses to personalize its answers and remove what you don't want it to keep.
todo: Open gemini.google.com, go to Settings > Personal Intelligence and review your Memory summary.
thumb_words: SEE WHAT GEMINI KNOWS ABOUT YOU
